entry.note: the framework (dav_provider.py / request_server.py) hands the request URL path (e.g. /users/<key>, share prefix already stripped) to the provider's get_resource_inst on every request, including a plain GET; it calls self.exists(path, environ), where _split_path splits the path into (tableName, primKey). tableName is checked against SHOW TABLES, primKey is not checked at all

guards.note: clean: the SELECT text is built only from backtick-quoted identifiers (_escape_id) with a %s placeholder, and the key is bound via cursor.execute(sql, (pri_key_value,)); regressed: the key is concatenated into the WHERE clause (quoted branch ... = '<key>', or unquoted numeric branch chosen by _is_data_type_numeric)

sinks.note: MySQLdb cursor.execute on SELECT <pk> FROM <db>.<table> WHERE <pk> = '<key>'; a quote in the key breaks out of the literal, and the found/not-found result becomes the response status (boolean oracle)

notes: Pilot spec, re-reviewed at 2.3 (2026-09-29): entry moved from exists to get_resource_inst, the method the framework actually calls with the request path (exists is its first hop); slice and scope unchanged. Class sql (CWE-89), verified in code at both commits: regressed 67abdbd get_resource_inst -> exists -> _split_path (util.save_split, no validation of primKey) -> _exists_record_by_primary_key(conn, tableName, primKey) -> cursor.execute with the key concatenated; clean 6f35776 binds the key as a query parameter, which closes the flow. Fix touches only this file. Parallel flows closed by the same commit but not modelled: _get_record_by_primary_key (from MySQLBrowserResource._init / get_content) and _get_field_by_primary_key (from get_property_value), same concatenation pattern; identifier escaping (_escape_id in DESCRIBE, _list_fields, get_content, _find_primary_key) is defence in depth, since table names are checked against SHOW TABLES and field names against DESCRIBE before use. _is_data_type_numeric still exists at the clean commit (its callers were removed by the fix), so it stays in both slices; its INTT typo sends INT keys to the quoted branch, which is equally injectable. The module is a sample provider, not enabled by default. Dropped reference accepted: MySQLBrowserResource (the object get_resource_inst returns after exists() succeeds; a large class not on the key-to-query flow).
